profile: direct-event v1 / Codex CLI 0.155.1 / Linux arm64 / headless command hooks / controlled writer

groups.boundary: native Codex adapter and delivery-only hook
checks: adapts the pinned Codex 0.155.1 native event fixture
adapts Add, Update, Delete and move sections independently
selects only an Update root uniquely corroborated by a nonempty added line
routes a native controlled-writer Codex Add through direct-event stdout
accepts exactly 64 KiB and rejects one byte above

groups.boundary: Git-aware named-path selection before source access
checks: honors nested .gitignore for untracked files and tracked semantics
does not load .git/info/exclude or global excludes
applies replacement includes, accumulated exclusions, and the hard floor
applies replacement includes, accumulated exclusions, and the hard floor

groups.boundary: descriptor-bound stable capture and analyzer containment
checks: accepts matching reads, BOM, and the exact byte limit
contains oversize, malformed UTF-8, and NUL input
contains mutation and deletion/recreation between reads
is interruptible without returning capture evidence
keeps valid work in an incomplete mixed-file observation without a ChangeSet

groups.boundary: TypeScript named-unit extraction and one DecisionModel request per complete unit
checks: extracts independent roots with finite recursive expanded and included evidence
accepts exactly 64 declarations and rejects the 65th
accepts exactly 16 referenced names excluding the root and rejects the 17th
rejects imports, declaration merging, and unsupported schema-only files
sends one request per Add unit with recursive supporting evidence
emits no empty advice after a successful clear
joins equivalent pending complete inputs before another evaluation reservation
reuses successful clear evaluations but never failures or malformed responses
restores cached A after A to B to A without retaining delivery history
bounds successful reuse by entry and byte limits and reevaluates evicted input
excludes event ids while including partition, path, evidence, contract, and immutable rules

groups.boundary: semantic revalidation and explicit publication authority
checks: allows unrelated file-context edits but suppresses relevant semantic changes
suppresses handoff on deletion, analyzer loss, or rule identity change
retires advice when recursive supporting evidence changes
does not let late A cleanup delete C after cached-clear B removes current state
requires controlled-writer authority and exact recipient association

groups.boundary: resident scheduling and bounded host collection
checks: dispatches an idle lone item immediately and puts sustained later arrivals in later cycles
never exceeds two running backend operations
becomes eligible at cycle completion or exactly 50 ms without resetting age
enforces five items and the exact 2 KiB host encoding
expires pending advice just before, at, and after the relevance boundary

groups.boundary: logical capacity ledger and bounded IPC decoding
checks: enforces the profile's exact 64/8MiB and 16/2MiB boundaries
accepts exact byte boundaries, rejects one byte over, and releases idempotently
reserves large valid outcomes before evaluation and rejects unreservable outcomes without a call
rejects an oversized request before writing recipient-bearing bytes
clears all reservations at a lifecycle terminal
uses an exact failure-triggered cooldown and resets state on restart
keeps capacity/backend and recipient partitions independent and batches with fresh findings
reclaims a full cooldown table at equality before the next admission
does not address unknown recipients or quiet applicability outcomes

groups.boundary: Linux singleton lifecycle and IPC ownership
checks: converges 100 starters across eight clients and keeps timed-out/disconnected work resident-owned
uses one absolute readiness deadline and caps every operation to remaining time
kills one lifetime, rejects obsolete messages, restarts empty, and cleans up only when idle
does not inherit a grant into a separate Git worktree and makes no provider call
reuses a grant, ignores project authorization, and revokes future dispatch
previews exact consent scope without writing and rejects a mismatched confirmation
rechecks consent after admission and before backend dispatch
loads current configuration at dispatch rather than freezing admission config

groups.boundary: Jev request policy through controlled DecisionModel
checks: uses a 15-second deadline and performs zero retries
does not retry a backend failure
